rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.quote: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.summary: Berkeley housing providers cannot ask about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decision-making.
rules.effective_date_evidence: On April 14, 2020, Berkeley City Council passed the Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (BMC 13.106).
rules.coverage_text: Applies to all rental housing providers in Berkeley except: lifetime sex offenders exemption; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties (1-3 units) where owner lives in one unit as primary residence; units under rental agreement allowing owners to move back per BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
rules.exemption_note: Owner-occupied properties (1-3 units) where owner lives in one unit as primary residence are exempt; lifetime sex offenders may be excluded; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8
rules.penalty: Administrative fines of at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation, civil damages including actual damages or three times the amount of one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief
